mapper.sql: id, group_id, url_name, url, open, description, fixed, create_time
mapper.select:
select
from gateway_permission gp left join (select dict_name, dict_val from gateway_dict where dict_type_id = 1) gd on gp.open = gd.dict_val ${ew.customSqlSegment}
select tr.id, role_name from t_role tr left join gateway_role_permission rp on tr.id = rp.role_id where rp.permission_id = #{id}

select group_name, group_create_time, id, group_id, url_name, url, open, description, fixed, create_time from ( select gpg.group_name, gpg.create_time as group_create_time, gp.id, gp.group_id, gp.url_name, gp.url, gp.open, gp.description, gp.fixed, gp.create_time, row_number() over ( partition by gp.group_id order by gp.create_time desc, gp.id desc ) as group_row from gateway_permission gp left join gateway_permission_group gpg on gpg.id = gp.group_id left join (select dict_name, dict_val from gateway_dict where dict_type_id = 1) gd on gp.open = gd.dict_val ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) group_permissions where group_id = 0 or group_row = 1 order by group_create_time desc nulls last, create_time desc nulls last
